podcast.title: 80s Tec-Pop Vibe Revival (Mid-2010s)
podcast.body: Around the mid-2010s, synth-based music with a distinct "80s tectopop vibe" started to see a resurgence. This indicates a cyclical return of electronic music styles from previous decades. "we started seeing more synth-based music that definitely had an 80s tectopop vibe."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 2: (90-81)

podcast.title: Basic Enduring Sound
podcast.body: Synth-based music is listed as one of the basic and enduring sounds that will never go away, but is continuously challenged by new genres. "The basic sounds are still with us. Rock, alternative, indie, Goth, industrial, metal, synth-based music, ska, reggae, and so on. They're never going to go away."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 3: The New Genres

podcast.title: Early Depeche Mode Sound (Late 1970s-Early 1980s)
podcast.body: Depeche Mode initially adopted a synth-based approach, which was very trendy during their formation period between 1977 and 1980, defining their sound for their early career. "Their synth-based approach was very trendy for the time, and for the next half-dozen years or so they were a mid-level band with a cult following in various parts of the world."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
